Thick-cut chunks of seafood and stock provides a satisfying savoriness.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Creamy Seafood Soups are made in [[Cooking Pot]]s by [[Cooking]] any seafood, [[Fresh Milk]], [[Rock Salt]], and any [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]] together. However, if [[Endura Carrot]]s, [[Swift Carrot]]s, or [[Fortified Pumpkin]]s are used, the resulting dish will be [[Veggie Cream Soup]]. Regular Creamy Seafood Soup can be made by using either a [[Hyrule Bass]] or a [[Sanke Carp]] in addition to Ingredients lacking any effects. Creamy Seafood Soups heal five of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s when eaten and sell for 40 [[Rupee]]s. The thick-cut chunks of seafood in these soups are known to provide a savory flavor. Based on the Ingredients used, the final [[Meal]] may be one of the following varieties: * '''Hearty Creamy Seafood Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Creamy Seafood Soup}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Thick-cut chunks of seafood and stock provides a satisfying savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Salmon]]s, [[Hearty Bass]], [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]]s, or other hearty Ingredients. Eating one of these soups will completely restore Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]]. They sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Energizing Creamy Seafood Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Creamy Seafood Soup}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Thick-cut chunks of seafood and stock provides a satisfying savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Staminoka Bass]]es, [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]s, or other stamina-boosting Ingredients. When eaten, Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] will be partially refilled. They heal eight of Link's Hearts and are worth 70 Rupees when sold. * '''Hasty Creamy Seafood Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Creamy Seafood Soup}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
Thick-cut chunks of seafood and stock provides a satisfying savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using speed-boosting Ingredients. Eating these soups will temporarily increase Link's movement speed. They heal three Hearts and sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Spicy Creamy Seafood Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Creamy Seafood Soup}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
Thick-cut chunks of seafood and stock provides a satisfying savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Sizzlefin Trout]]s or other spicy Ingredients. When these are eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. They also restore five Hearts and sell for 40 Rupees. * '''Electro Creamy Seafood Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Creamy Seafood Soup}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
Thick-cut chunks of seafood and stock provides a satisfying savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Voltfin Trout]] or other electricity-related Ingredients. When consumed, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]] for a short period of time. They heal eight of Link's Hearts and can also be sold for 40 Rupees. * '''Mighty Creamy Seafood Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Creamy Seafood Soup}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Thick-cut chunks of seafood and stock provides a satisfying savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Mighty Carp]], [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]], [[Razorclaw Crab]]s, or other attack-boosting Ingredients. Eating one will increase the damage of Link's attacks for a time. They replenish five of Link's Hearts and sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Tough Creamy Seafood Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Creamy Seafood Soup}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Thick-cut chunks of seafood and stock provides a satisfying savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Armored Carp]], [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]], [[Ironshell Crab]]s, or other defensive Ingredients. If eaten, Link's [[Defense]] will be temporarily increased. They heal eight of Link's Hearts and sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Sneaky Creamy Seafood Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Creamy Seafood Soup}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
Thick-cut chunks of seafood and stock provides a satisfying savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Stealthfin Trout]]s, [[Sneaky River Snail]]s, or other sneaky Ingredients. Eating one of these soups will increase Link's [[Stealth]] abilities. They heal five Hearts and are worth 50 Rupees when sold. * '''Chilly Creamy Seafood Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Creamy Seafood Soup}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
Thick-cut chunks of seafood and stock provides a satisfying savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Chillfin Trout]]s or other chilly Ingredients. When eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. They restore five of Link's Hearts and can be sold for 40 Rupees. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The [[Recipe]] for Creamy Seafood Soup is obtained by completing the [[Scenario]] "[[Water and Fire]]". It is made using one [[Big Hearty Radish]], one [[Staminoka Bass]], one [[Fresh Milk]], and one [[Rock Salt]]. Preparing Creamy Seafood Soup before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]] increases the [[Warrior]]s' [[Special Attack]] charge rate by seven percent. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Creamy Seafood Soup Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Creamy Seafood Soup icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Creamy Heart Soup * Creamy Meat Soup * Food * Veggie Cream Soup }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood, Soups |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
